response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_dur) AS avg_of_avg_rental_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_rate_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_dur, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) t

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is computed per film as rental_rate / replacement_cost and then averaged within each rating. Films with NULL values are ignored by AVG, and replacement_cost is NOT NULL so no division by zero occurs.
The final row is an unweighted average of the per-rating averages, so each rating counts equally regardless of how many films it has.
